title: PrjGovAssessment
description: DGRF Structural Project Governance Risk Assessment Schema (Dimensions D1 - D5)

projectId.description: Unique identifier for the project evaluated

assessor.description: Name or email of the executive/governance assessor

d1_authority.title: D1: Decision-Making Authority & Sponsorship
d1_authority.description: Calibration of single-threaded executive ownership vs diffuse steering committees (Max 25 pts). 3: Single accountable executive with unilateral mandate. 10: Clear steering sponsor with bounded delegation. 18: Fragmented multi-stakeholder consensus required. 25: Unclear ownership, paralyzed decision-rights or absentee sponsor.

d2_procurement.title: D2: Procurement Alignment & Vendor Contracting
d2_procurement.description: Incentive alignment, fixed-price vs agile risk sharing, vendor accountability (Max 20 pts). 3: Outcome-linked milestones with shared risk-reward. 9: Time & Materials with strong performance gates. 15: Rigid fixed-price waterfall contract with adversarial terms. 20: Cost-plus without penalty or misaligned offshore vendor lock-in.

d3_scope_ccb.title: D3: Scope Control & Change Control Board (CCB)
d3_scope_ccb.description: Discipline of scope intake, threshold variance control, and architectural integrity (Max 20 pts). 3: Rigorous CCB with trade-off mandate (scope drop required for new additions). 9: Formal CCB with cost/schedule impact analysis. 15: Permissive CCB with frequent emergency exemptions. 20: Uncontrolled scope creep with direct executive backdoor additions.

d4_risk_contingency.title: D4: Risk Contingency & Reserves Allocation
d4_risk_contingency.description: Adequacy of unallocated financial & schedule buffers under sponsor control (Max 20 pts). 3: Actuarially validated contingency (>=20%) controlled by project lead. 8: Standard management reserve (10-15%) with clear drawdown protocol. 14: Minimal contingency (<5%) absorbed into baseline immediately. 20: Zero contingency reserve or artificial buffer shaving by finance.

d5_architecture_coupling.title: D5: Architectural Coupling & Technical Debt Governance
d5_architecture_coupling.description: Governance over architectural dependency, legacy entanglement, and non-functional sign-off (Max 15 pts). 2: Loosely coupled microservices/modular monolith with clean API contracts. 7: Bounded monolith with documented integration boundaries. 11: High coupling to legacy core systems with synchronous dependencies. 15: Undocumented spaghetti entanglement with zero regression automation.
